About the job
Kraanvogel Automation develops motion control systems, industrial PCs and engineering software for machine builders. We employ 640 people, generate EUR 210 million in revenue and sell through our own sales companies in eight European countries. Germany, Austria and Switzerland form our largest region with around 40 % of revenue.

Our Managing Director DACH left the company in September. While we search for a permanent successor, we want an experienced interim sales leader to keep the momentum, protect our key accounts and prepare the launch of our new controller generation in March 2027.

Your responsibilities
• Lead the DACH sales organisation with 11 people (key account managers, area sales managers and inside sales)
• Secure order intake and pipeline for Q4 2026 and Q1 2027, including the year-end negotiations with our top 25 OEM accounts
• Prepare the go-to-market plan for the new controller generation in DACH together with product management and marketing
• Review pricing and discount structures for distributors and OEMs
• Bring discipline to pipeline management and forecasting in Salesforce
• Hand over a stable team to the permanent Managing Director DACH

Your profile
• 12+ years in B2B sales of automation technology, machinery or industrial software, of which at least 5 years leading sales teams
• Experience with OEM key account management and distributor channels in DACH
• Hands-on Salesforce user with a structured approach to pipeline and forecast
• Native-level German and fluent English
• Willingness to travel to customers in DACH for about 40 % of your time

Engagement details
• Interim assignment for 9 months, starting as soon as possible
• Fully remote from Germany, Austria or Switzerland; no office presence in Amsterdam required apart from a quarterly leadership meeting
• Day rate: EUR 1,100 to 1,250 plus travel expenses
• Contract with Kraanvogel Automation B.V., invoiced through your own company
